Name: AutoLoading
Author: SMVESJSUN
Description:
1.1
手拿物品对着已经完成的机器（如酒桶、小罐、熔炉等）单独按下互动键或工具键
Hold an item and press the interact key or tool key on a completed machine (such as a keg, preserves jar, furnace, etc.) individually.

Downloads.Description:
从机器中取出物品时，自动用手持物重新填充机器
When taking an item out of the machine, the item you are holding will be automatically placed into the machine.

Manifest.Name: AutoLoading
Manifest.Description: Automatically refill machine with the currently held item when harvest wine from them
